# CI test shards. One shard per line: <name> <package> [<package>...]
#
# A package is one path (./internal/api), not a ./... pattern. The shard
# named rest lists no packages: it is every package in this module that
# the other lines do not name, so a new package is tested without a
# workflow edit. .github/scripts/test-shards.sh reads this file.
#
# The seven packages over 90s each have their own shard (measured for #416).
# Move lines when a package's time changes. A package with no line of its
# own runs in rest.

sts-agent ./internal/sts/agent
deploy ./deploy
artifact ./internal/platform/artifact
api ./internal/api
daemon ./internal/controller/daemon
state ./internal/platform/state
md-agent ./internal/md/agent
rest
